services.name: Event Rentals
services.desc: The Center is Dallas’ premier location for performances and special occasions, from parties and intimate gatherings to galas and grand exhibitions. The Center’s 10-acre campus in the heart of the Dallas Arts District is the ideal setting for celebrations, receptions, conferences, meetings, shows - or any experience that brings people together in community. From small spaces to grand stages, you’ll find just the right space at the Winspear Opera House, Wyly Theatre, Sammons Park or Strauss Square. services.name: Programs We Offer
services.desc: From musical theatre opportunities to our Ballet Folklórico contest, we offer students of all ages the opportunity to explore their creativity while gaining life-long skills. Open Stages expands opportunities for middle and high school students to experience professional live performances - a first for many. Through pre-show workshops taught by local teaching artists, students also explore themes within the show. Backstage Spotlight offers high schoolers hands-on stage production experience. Ideal for students interested in pursuing a theatre career, they develop portfolios throughout the program to help them demonstrate their stage technician abilities to colleges and future employers.
